# Create, Rig, and Animate a Production-Ready 3D Character

<a href="https://x.com/higgsfield_ai/status/2096342420543660277">
  <img src="../assets/readme-previews/agi-is-100-solved-660277.jpg" alt="Create, Rig, and Animate a Production-Ready 3D Character result preview" width="900" />
</a>

An end-to-end agent workflow designs a character, builds and retopologizes it in Blender, rigs it, evaluates it, and turns it into an animation.

- **Model:** GPT-6 Astra
- **Engine:** Blender
- **Category:** Blender Scenes
- **Prompt fidelity:** Exact source instruction
- **Source checked:** 2026-09-07
- **Creator:** [Higgsfield AI 🧩](https://x.com/higgsfield_ai/status/2096342420543660277)
- **Rights:** review-required; preview and prompt retain source attribution

## Prompt

~~~~text
Take control of my computer using GPT-6 Astra and do the following:

1. design a character concept using Higgsfield Soul 2.0,

2. build a textured 3D model of it,

3. import it into Blender,

4. retopologize the mesh,

5. create a UV map,

6. build a character rig,

7. evaluate how production-ready the model is,

8. redo previous steps if you're not satisfied with results,

9. and then turn it into a cartoon using Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield
~~~~
